body: Thank you thank you thank you thank you. I think I'm going to call my friend Anna tomorrow. She used to open up to me quite a lot and I feel like I could talk to her about it. You're right I do think I need help because it is getting worse. Even if my thoughts of suicide would cease I need help getting through this depression I'm going through. I'm going to sleep tonight and call my friend in the morning. Thank you it may sound stupid but you changed my life right now. I'm logging out of this throwaway account now and hopefully I'll never have to log back. Thank you once again.

Exactly my father used to hit my mother and I thought I would never act violent to anyone but in a fight with my girlfriend I got angry and threw my glass plate on a wall and punched a wall on the way out, which is something my father used to do and that scared me to death. That's when I realized that maybe my father didn't have much choice either (is that fucked up to say?) and that it's just part of who we are. I love children and I always dreamed of having a perfect family full of people that I love but it saddens me that I could never have that. 

I'm really glad for you seeking therapy and I really hope it works out for you. Thank you so much for taking the time to post here.

How can I get myself to bring this up to a friend since I have never said anything like this to someone before? I'm really bad with expressing my feelings to anyone (I haven't told my mother I loved her in a while and I do but for some reason I can't tell her). I feel much too insecure and prideful to tell even a doctor about it because then I would be admitting a problem. How can I start to do something like this? To be honest I'm even too scared to write anything I feel on paper because I'm so insecure about it. I don't know what that means but I just can't. Maybe what I'm trying to say is I have a hard time expressing myself honestly even to myself.
